description:
Social State’s debut album ‘Sacrosanct’ features collaborations with JD. Reid, Chunky and Mr. Mitch.

"I told myself at 15 that I had to make an album one day that truly represents my musical influences. It's taken me a minute but this is it..."

"That 15-year-old kid was the bassist in a metal band, constantly stealing his sister's jungle tapes and spending evenings trying
to make beats on Fruity Loops. I think he would love this album"
